arms.name: Complete SkillGen
arms.paper_behavior: Run contrastive induction, refinement, verification gate, Failure Lessons, and script/reference bundles where enabled by the paper setup.
arms.implementation_method: Use the normal SkillGen configuration as the paired reference arm.
arms.safety_note: Full must use the same split, model route, judge route, and seed as every ablation arm.
arms.rollback_note: No rollback needed; this is the reference arm.

arms.name: ICL k=3 instead of induced skill
arms.paper_behavior: Replace induced skill generation with three in-context demonstrations.
arms.implementation_method: Select three baseline-success construction trajectories with seed 42, render them as a Markdown demonstration skill, skip induction/refinement for this arm, and evaluate the demonstration skill through eval_skill.py.
arms.safety_note: Demonstrations must come only from construction trajectories; held-out test instances must not leak into the skill text.
arms.rollback_note: Delete the generated demonstration skill and rerun the normal Full generation path.

arms.name: No refinement
arms.paper_behavior: Use the initial generated candidate skill without later refinement rounds.
arms.implementation_method: Set pipeline.max_refine_rounds to 1 so only the initial generation round is evaluated.
arms.safety_note: Keep verification output for round 1 so failures and regressions remain auditable.
arms.rollback_note: Restore pipeline.max_refine_rounds to the Full arm value.

arms.name: No verification gate
arms.paper_behavior: Disable the construction-time gate that rejects skills without positive verification gain.
arms.implementation_method: Record verification results normally, but force the selected candidate into held-out evaluation even when the gate fails. If the official code marks failed skills as DEPRECATED, the ablation runner must override that status only for this arm.
arms.safety_note: This arm intentionally disables a safety/quality gate; raw failed-gate evidence must be preserved before held-out evaluation.
arms.rollback_note: Remove the A3 runner override and restore normal deprecated-skill/no-op handling.

arms.name: No Failure Lessons
arms.paper_behavior: Remove Failure Lessons from the skill generation/refinement process.
arms.implementation_method: Preferred path: patch generation/refinement prompts so they neither request nor emit a Failure Lessons section. Fallback path: remove the final '## Failure lessons' section before held-out evaluation and label it as a weaker post-process ablation.
arms.safety_note: If the fallback post-process path is used, record that the generator still saw failure evidence during construction.
arms.rollback_note: Restore the original generation/refinement prompts and skill post-processing.

arms.name: Plain-text skill, no script/reference bundle
arms.paper_behavior: Disable executable helper scripts and reference bundles so the skill is plain text only.
arms.implementation_method: Set generation.generate_scripts and generation.generate_references to false for this arm.
arms.safety_note: Only compare A5 against Full on dataset-model pairs where Full actually enables script/reference bundles.
arms.rollback_note: Restore script/reference generation to the Full arm setting.
